opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening when it is illuminated.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a picnic in the surrounding gardens.

places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and the tallest brick minaret in the world, showcasing Indo-Islamic architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Explore the nearby Iron Pillar and other monuments in the complex.

places.name: Lotus Temple
places.ai_summary: A Bahá'í House of Worship known for its flowerlike shape and serene gardens, open to all religions.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Maintain silence inside the temple for prayer and meditation.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and other nearby tombs in the complex.
